title: Improving language understanding with unsupervised learning
summary: OpenAI published Improving language understanding with unsupervised learning on June 11, 2018, describing and releasing a scalable, task-agnostic language system that combined Transformer models with unsupervised pre-training followed by supervised fine-tuning across diverse language tasks.
significance: A documented OpenAI language-model research and release milestone for generative pre-training with a Transformer-based model before the later GPT-2 publication.

verification.note: OpenAI's first-party June 11, 2018 publication establishes the dated public research/release milestone and explicitly describes a scalable task-agnostic system combining Transformers and unsupervised pre-training, with model release. The linked OpenAI technical report identifies Radford, Narasimhan, Salimans, and Sutskever as authors and documents the generative pre-training/fine-tuning method. This record does not retroactively assert that OpenAI used the product/model name GPT-1 on that date, and it does not infer geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships.
